observed_operations: getOpenTransactionsForTopics is a static method that is entered only when a caller invokes it.
The method synchronously obtains producer IDs through getProducerIds/getProducerStates/getTopicPartitions/getTopicMetadata, each of which invokes Kafka Admin operations and waits via .get().
It then calls admin.listTransactions(new ListTransactionsOptions().filterProducerIds(...).filterStates(ONGOING)).all().get() and returns the resulting collection.

AdminUtils.java contains no Timer, Thread construction, Executor/ExecutorService, ScheduledExecutor, scheduler, callback registration, periodic loop, event listener, or background trigger that independently invokes getOpenTransactionsForTopics.
source.source_search_anchor: GitHub code search located the exact pinned AdminUtils.java and its call from TransactionAbortStrategyContextImpl.java; the full AdminUtils.java was then fetched at the same commit.

finding.summary: At pinned apache/flink-connector-kafka commit dc707db60fcf3c0637114503c27685c881519c2c, AdminUtils.getOpenTransactionsForTopics is a caller-entered helper that issues Kafka Admin requests and blocks for their results; AdminUtils itself does not introduce an autonomous timer/thread/scheduler/background initiation path for open-transaction listing.
finding.falsifying_trace: Without an external caller entering AdminUtils.getOpenTransactionsForTopics, no code in AdminUtils.java schedules or re-invokes that helper. Once called, it requests metadata/producer state and listTransactions from the supplied Admin instance and waits for completion using Future.get().
finding.scope_guard: AdminUtils.java only at commit dc707db60fcf3c0637114503c27685c881519c2c. No claim about Kafka Admin client internals, Kafka broker transaction expiry, Flink runtime scheduling, TransactionAbortStrategy invocation sites, or any other component that may autonomously call this helper.
finding.asynchrony_boundary: Kafka Admin implementations may execute their requested operations asynchronously internally; that is not evidence that AdminUtils autonomously initiates the listing. This finding concerns initiation by AdminUtils only.

phase1_assessment.residual_richer_mode_protected_manual_de: The observed AdminUtils path still requires an executing caller and therefore is not, by itself, a zero-residual scheduled-Chat parity mechanism.
phase1_assessment.finite_monthly_quota_dependency: none implicated or consumed for evidence gathering

frontier.exact_next_action: Fresh-bootstrap next invocation, then inspect exactly one official pinned apache/flink-connector-kafka source family that invokes TransactionAbortStrategyContext/getOpenTransactionsForTopics during sink operation, to determine what event or runtime path triggers abort inspection. Preserve caller-site-only scope; distinguish explicit writer/checkpoint/recovery invocation from periodic/autonomous scheduling, and do not generalize to Kafka Admin internals or broker expiry.
